summary: Frontend-only regression testing of the redesigned CandleFlame exercise. All acceptance criteria pass: candle-scene, candle-svg, candle-mandala-backdrop (src includes 'candle-mandala', naturalWidth 495 → asset loaded), and exactly 16 candle-spark elements render. Timer starts at 5:00, counts down after Play (verified 4:57 after 3.5s), reset returns to 5:00. Flame group computed animationName is 'none' before Play and 'candle-flame-flicker' after Play — animation gating on isPlaying prop works. No page errors on candle scene or on the 3 sibling exercises (flower-observation, expanding-circle, breath-counter). All 4 Focus cards render on /focus and clicking Start on Candle Flame navigates to the player.

issues: Mandala backdrop is quite subtle in light mode / at 1920x1080 (opacity 0.55 + screen blend on a dark radial background). Reference image showed a more prominent geometric mandala. Consider bumping opacity or brightness if the intent was stronger visual presence. Not a bug — visual polish only.

critical_code_review_comments: CandleFlame.jsx is a self-contained all-SVG component with @keyframes injected via a <style> tag inside JSX — fine here, but if this exercise is ever mounted twice concurrently the duplicate <style> would still be idempotent by browser dedup. No action needed.
prefers-reduced-motion rule inside the injected <style> uses `.candle-scene *, .candle-scene g` to disable all animations — good accessibility touch.
Sparks memoized with useMemo and no deps — deterministic per mount which is correct (avoids reshuffling on re-render).
